summary: Quick play radio station app with a very light mood/theme
imageRequirements:
## Required Images
- Soft pastel radio wave illustration with gentle circular ripples in warm white and light coral tones, used as a hero background (radio-hero-light.dim_1200x600.png)

existing_features.title: Implement a Quick Play feature that automatically starts playing the first available or last-played radio station as soon as the app loads, without requiring the user to manually select a station first.

Redesign the entire app UI with a very light, airy mood: use a soft white or pale pastel color palette, clean minimal typography, gentle spacing, and subtle soft-shadow cards. Replace the current dark space/star theme with a bright, calm, cheerful aesthetic throughout all components (Header, TopToolbar, AudioPlayer, RadioPlaybackDisplay, SearchOverlay, UserDashboard, Footer, LoadingScreen).
Update the Tailwind configuration and global CSS (index.css) to define a light theme token set (background, surface, text, accent, border colors) and apply it consistently across all components.
